clips.title: The story
paras: Slimy Menace addresses a growing murloc infestation along the shores of Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest. These aggressive creatures threaten to deplete the lake's fish supply and endanger nearby locals, requiring swift action to keep their numbers in check.

Along the eastern shore of Crystal Lake, an aggressive enclave of murlocs has established a foothold. These savage, semi-aquatic creatures possess sharp teeth and fierce tempers, turning a once-peaceful body of water into a dangerous feeding ground. Local residents rely heavily on the lake for their daily livelihoods, but the murloc presence now threatens anyone daring to fish or approach the water's edge.

Beyond the physical danger they present to travelers, the murlocs threaten to devour every fish in the lake if allowed to multiply unchecked. Thinning their numbers provides a much-needed respite for the local waters, though their eerie, echoing warbles remain a grim reminder of their tenacity. Even when scattered, murlocs replenish their ranks swiftly, ensuring that vigilant watch over the shoreline remains an ongoing necessity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.
If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
